notes: Add per-port comment and UDP toggle to the Clients-tab NAT ports popup (for tools like RustDesk that need both TCP and UDP on the same port), and a hot-update safety net: daomai-agent now verifies a downloaded update zip's agent binary and web UI actually match before committing to the swap, so a mismatched release package fails cleanly with rollback instead of silently rebooting the router. Also fixes SQLite snapshot lock contention and a stale NAT ports popup.
